settings.title: Check every component
settings.instruction: Lay out every item before you begin. Do not install KRYO if anything is missing or damaged.
settings.actions:
• KRYO
  • Two-metre hose
  • Halo with flow adjuster
  • Rubber seals
  • UAE PSU and plug
  • Fill-opening plug
  • Mounting rail
  • Sliding connector
  • Phillips-head screwdriver
settings.warning: The rubber seals are small but essential. Keep them with the hose fittings.

settings.title: Give KRYO room to breathe
settings.instruction: Place KRYO upright on a stable, level floor. Leave a clear gap behind it so warm air can exit from the rear.
settings.warning: Do not press the rear against a wall, towel or curtain.
settings.why: Restricted airflow can reduce cooling performance and may cause overheating.

settings.title: Check reach before mounting
settings.instruction: The hose, power cable and refill access determine the best rail position.
settings.actions:
1. Connect the hose and Halo.
  2. Hold the rail in the proposed position.
  3. Check the hose reaches without pulling or kinking.
  4. Check the PSU reaches a suitable wall outlet.
  5. Check a bidet or shower hose can reach the fill opening.
  6. Keep spray away from KRYO’s display and power side.
settings.warning: Do not remove the rail adhesive backing yet.
settings.tip: The display and power button are on KRYO’s right-hand side. Mount the Halo on the opposite side where possible.

settings.title: Insert the sliding connector
settings.actions:
1. Remove one plastic end cap with the supplied screwdriver.
  2. Slide the height-adjustable connector into the rail.
  3. Press the button and confirm it moves freely.
  4. Refit the end cap.
  5. Tighten the screw without overtightening.

settings.title: Position above the tallest user
settings.instruction: The Halo should sit at least 30 cm above the tallest user’s head. Where space allows, 40 to 50 cm provides broader shoulder coverage.
settings.tip: Higher placement helps water spread across the tops of the shoulders and create a wider film over the upper body.

settings.title: Test the final position
settings.instruction: Fit the Halo and hose to the slider. Hold the complete rail against the wall and check the setup one final time.
settings.actions:
• Rail is vertical
  • Halo is high enough
  • Hose is not stretched
  • Hose has no sharp kink
  • Spray points away from the power side
  • Rear airflow stays clear
  • Refill hose reaches KRYO
  • Power cable reaches safely
settings.tip: Mark the rail position with removable tape.

settings.title: Clean and dry the surface
settings.instruction: The wall must be smooth, clean, dry and free from soap film, oil, dust or loose material.
settings.warning: Use only the preparation method approved for your wall and the supplied adhesive.

settings.title: Get the first placement right
settings.instruction: The adhesive is strongest when the rail is aligned correctly the first time.
settings.actions:
1. Remove the adhesive covers.
  2. Align the rail with your marks.
  3. Make first contact carefully.
  4. Press firmly across every adhesive point.
  5. Allow the approved setting time before loading the rail.
settings.warning: Get the alignment right on first contact.

settings.title: Check both seals
settings.instruction: A rubber seal must sit flat inside each hose fitting.
settings.actions:
• Correct: seal flat and centred.
  • Incorrect: missing, twisted or pinched.
settings.warning: A missing or misaligned seal can cause leaking.

settings.title: Make both water connections
settings.actions:
1. Hand-tighten one hose end onto the Halo.
  2. Hand-tighten the other end onto KRYO’s outlet.
  3. Check the hose follows a smooth path.
  4. Keep the Halo flow adjuster closed.
  5. Keep KRYO’s water-flow control off.

settings.title: Keep mains power dry
settings.instruction: The PSU converts the UAE wall supply to 24V DC for KRYO.
settings.actions:
1. Keep KRYO switched off.
  2. Dry your hands.
  3. Connect KRYO’s 24V DC lead to the PSU.
  4. Place the PSU and connection outside the splash zone.
  5. Connect the UAE plug to a suitable wall outlet.
  6. Route cables away from water and foot traffic.
settings.warning_title: DO NOT PLUG OR UNPLUG WITH WET HANDS
settings.warning: Keep the PSU, plug and connections outside the splash zone.

settings.title: Never start KRYO dry
settings.instruction: The internal circulation system needs water before KRYO is switched on.
settings.actions: Add clean water through the top opening until the system is primed.
settings.warning_title: RUNNING DRY MAY DAMAGE THE PUMP
settings.warning: Never switch KRYO on before adding priming water.
settings.why: The exact minimum priming volume is pending confirmation and is not published here.

settings.title: Switch on and listen
settings.actions:
1. Switch KRYO on.
  2. Confirm the internal light turns on.
  3. Listen for smooth internal circulation.
settings.warning_title: IF YOU HEAR A HARSH DRY-RUNNING SOUND
settings.warning: Switch KRYO off immediately and add more water.

settings.title: Watch the water level
settings.instruction: Keep the internal light on while filling so you can see the level clearly.
settings.actions:
1. Add clean water slowly.
  2. Stop at the safe level shown.
  3. Never let water overflow into the upper internal area.
settings.warning: Do not fill to the top of the opening.
settings.why: The exact maximum fill level is pending confirmation and is not published here.

settings.title: Fit the top plug
settings.actions:
1. Wipe away spills.
  2. Dry the top surface.
  3. Insert the supplied fill-opening plug.
  4. Confirm it sits correctly.

settings.title: Start at 15°C
settings.instruction: Press SET and choose approximately 15°C for your first session. Lower the temperature gradually only after you know how your body responds.
settings.warning: Never set KRYO below 1°C. Never allow the reservoir to freeze.

settings.title: Your KRYO is ready
settings.instruction: Run through the final check before your first session.
settings.actions:
• Rear airflow is clear
  • Rail is secure
  • Hose is not kinked
  • Both seals are fitted
  • PSU is dry and outside the splash zone
  • Water is below the maximum level
  • Starting temperature is around 15°C

settings.title: Broad cold coverage. Compact design.
settings.instruction: The Halo balances coverage, flow and droplet size to create a film of cold water over the upper body. Positioning it above your head helps water spread across the shoulders and carry heat away from more skin.
settings.warning: KRYO is a different experience from full-body immersion. A short, very cold session can still feel extremely powerful and produce a strong sense of alertness.

settings.title: Begin around 15°C
settings.instruction: KRYO can feel more intense than expected. Use a warmer temperature, lower flow and short exposure for your first session.

settings.title: Do not face the first flow
settings.instruction: Stand with your back to the Halo. Let water land across the tops of your shoulders or upper back before slowly rotating.
settings.warning_title: DO NOT DIRECT THE FIRST FLOW AT YOUR FACE OR CHEST
settings.warning: Begin with your back toward the Halo.

settings.title: Control the intensity
settings.instruction:
Lower flow — around 5 L/min for a gentler experience, cooling down and longer reservoir use.

Higher flow — around 8 to 10 L/min for a more intense experience, larger droplets and stronger wind chill.
settings.warning: Higher flow uses the reservoir much faster.
settings.why: Flow values remain configurable pending final production validation.

settings.title: Stay in control
settings.actions:
1. Stand with your back to the Halo.
  2. Start the flow.
  3. Breathe normally.
  4. Let water spread across your shoulders.
  5. Rotate gradually only when comfortable.
  6. End immediately if you feel unwell.

settings.title: Stop immediately if something feels wrong
settings.instruction: Stop the flow and move to a safe, warm environment if you experience any of the following.
settings.actions:
• Chest pain
  • Severe breathlessness
  • Dizziness or faintness
  • Confusion
  • Loss of coordination
  • Uncontrolled shivering
  • Blue or unusually pale skin
  • Racing or irregular heartbeat
  • Panic or loss of breathing control
settings.warning: Seek urgent medical help for severe or persistent symptoms.

settings.title: First session complete
settings.instruction: Close the Halo flow adjuster, switch off the water flow and check the remaining water level.
settings.actions:
• Top up when needed
  • Wipe splash from display and power side
  • Check connections for drips
  • Keep rear airflow clear
